articulation.label: banana
articulation.alt: banana: /b/ → /ə/ → /n/ → /æ/ → /n/ → /ə/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: hotel
articulation.alt: hotel: /h/ → /oʊ/ → /t/ → /ɛ/ → /l/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: teacher
articulation.alt: teacher: /t/ → /i/ → /tʃ/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/i/: High, front tongue; lips relaxed.
/tʃ/: Brief closure, then a narrow sh-like release.
/ɚ/: A lighter, unstressed r-colored vowel.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: today
articulation.alt: today: /t/ → /ə/ → /d/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
